conbody.p: At the top of the page, Part of names the project this one belongs under, and Child projects links to the projects that belong under it. A subsystem or supplier project sits under the system it is part of: its requirements can then refine the parent's, and the parent's V&V rolls those refinements up. Choose another project under Part of to move it, or No parent to make it top-level. A project cannot go under itself or under one of its own children. This used to be set in project settings.
